Name: MH Questable Backpacks
Author: mahsouto
Description:
[size=6][b][center]MH Questable Backpacks[/center][/b][/size]
A progression-based secondary inventory system. Earn a special backpack through a quest chain and upgrade it six tiers, unlocking up to 96 extra slots. Each upgrade requires specific materials and NPC interactions.


[b][size=4]Features
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=2]Six-tier progression system with upgrades from 12 to 96 slots[/size]
[size=2]
[/size][/list][list]
[*]Quest-driven progression
[list]
[*]Start with a letter from Robin after day 7
[*]Complete quests to unlock each tier upgrade
[*]NPCs involved: Robin, Linus, Marlon, and the Wizard
[*]Material requirements increase with each tier
[*]Each tier costs gold and specific resources


[/list][*]Dedicated inventory slot
[list]
[*]Backpack lives in its own UI slot (bottom-left corner)
[*]Doesn't consume main inventory space
[*]Click to open (or press O key can change in config)
[*]Customizable position in config
[/list][/list]
[b][size=2]This is my first mod of this type, so it may contain unexpected errors. I appreciate your feedback.
[/size][/b][center][size=4]
Check out all my mods on [/size][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mahsouto?gameId=1303]my profile[/url][/center]
